author: David Betz and Michael Rainsborough
description:
Slowly but surely Britain is becoming Sovietised, say Prof David Betz and Prof Michael Rainsborough. Not yet the full-fat version, but already the late-stage system of approved narratives and controlled thought.

The post Have I Got Approved Views for You: The Creeping Sovietisation of Britain appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Have I Got Approved Views for You: The Creeping Sovietisation of Britain

author: Will Jones
description:
Sir Keir Starmer is facing calls to quit today over "lies" after it emerged that Peter Mandelson failed security vetting for his role as US ambassador but officials were overruled by the Foreign Office.

The post Starmer Told to Quit Over “Lies” as it Emerges Mandelson Failed Security Vetting But Officials Were Overruled appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Starmer Told to Quit Over “Lies” as it Emerges Mandelson Failed Security Vetting But Officials Were Overruled

author: Will Jones
description:
One in five teenagers in the UK do not share their political views due to a fear of being cancelled, according to a new report from the Economist Educational Foundation.

The post Teens Staying Silent on Politics for Fear of Being Cancelled appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Teens Staying Silent on Politics for Fear of Being Cancelled

author: Will Jones
description:
The Green Party plans to splurge 2.5% of GDP – more than the current defence budget – on international aid while focusing its strategic defence review on Net Zero.

The post Greens Would Spend 2.5% of GDP – More Than the Defence Budget – on Foreign Aid and Focus Military Review on Net Zero appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Greens Would Spend 2.5% of GDP – More Than the Defence Budget – on Foreign Aid and Focus Military Review on Net Zero

author: Will Jones
description:
Protesters in Epsom have demanded police release descriptions and CCTV footage of the men suspected of gang raping a woman amid suspicions that the information is being withheld owing to the ethnicity of the suspects.

The post Epsom Protesters Demand Descriptions of Gang-Rape Suspects appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Epsom Protesters Demand Descriptions of Gang-Rape Suspects

author: Joanna Gray
description:
The suggestion that the British public school system retains the best of Western civilisation is becoming harder to defend thanks to its continued insistence on throwing up frightful new school buildings, says Joanna Gray.

The post Private School New Buildings Are an Utter Disgrace appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Private School New Buildings Are an Utter Disgrace

author: Ben Pile
description:
Tony Blair has weighed in on Net Zero again, repeating his call for energy pragmatism over ideology. It might sound helpful, but don't be fooled, says Ben Pile: read closely and he lets slip his real agenda.

The post Tony Blair Weighs in on Net Zero Again – and Lets Slip His Real Agenda appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Tony Blair Weighs in on Net Zero Again – and Lets Slip His Real Agenda
